purpose: Additive World Art finisher questions; existing frozen fixtures are unchanged.

questions.query: How do I open the World Art viewer on Windows with all fifteen collections and 120 features?
facts: Extract the portable ZIP and open Open World Art.cmd; Godot and Python are included.
Open Gallery.cmd opens verified real-Godot scene and feature captures.
No native extension, Rapier runtime, second atlas checkout or C++ build is required.

questions.query: Can World Art preview 512x8192 and 16384x1024 art, and does that increase native playable World sizes?
facts: The art adapter accepts up to16384 cells per axis and16777216 source cells.
Those art-only dimensions grant no native simulation/import/save admission.
Ordinary full export is50M pixels; explicit streamed export is100M and65536 per output axis.

questions.query: How do I retry interrupted unattended World Art captures without overwriting evidence?
facts: Retain incomplete output and choose a new destination.
The tool refuses nonempty and retained-claim directories and does not take over uncertain writers.
Manifest, PNG, batch/child inventory and source integrity verification are required for completion.

questions.query: How does pinning World Art preserve source identity and settings for before and after comparison?
facts: Pinning retains rendered pixels, source hash/path, scene or feature/variant, dimensions, camera and presentation.
Before viewport/detail exports use the pin original provenance; full exports render current source.
Use explicit reload on a writable copy; invalid input leaves the last good rendering.

questions.query: Does headless Godot or Windows ANGLE qualification establish physical GPU acceptance for the art viewer?
facts: Display-less Godot headless cannot provide framebuffer evidence; unattended Linux uses X11/Xvfb.
Windows hosted ANGLE is distinct from physical Windows/NVIDIA owner acceptance.
Cross-driver PNG hash equality is not required.
